activeFounderGate.whatThisIs: Choose whether the agent should prepare the business for unattended work.
activeFounderGate.whyNow: This resolves required tools, roles, limits, deployments, assets, and store uploads before build work.
activeFounderGate.founderAction: Choose the recommended step-away setup or an assisted setup.

question.prompt: Choose the recommended step-away setup or an assisted setup.

options.label: Step-away mode
options.description: Verify the required access and create standing authority for routine launch operations.
options.consequence: The agent can build, deploy the named website, create assets, update store material, and upload test builds without repeat approvals.
options.agentActionNext: Run the consolidated readiness preflight, record standing envelopes, and start every ready area.
options.evidenceEffect: The ledger shows unattended readiness or one consolidated list of missing items.

options.label: Assisted mode
options.description: Keep external mutations review-first while the agent prepares drafts and local builds.
options.consequence: The founder stays involved for provider changes, deployments, and uploads.
options.agentActionNext: Continue reversible local work and bring one consolidated external-action request when needed.

bypassPolicy.reason: Local and reversible work can continue without standing external authority.
bypassPolicy.fallbackAction: Continue research, design, local builds, drafts, and readiness discovery.
bypassPolicy.revisitTrigger: Before the first provider mutation, website deployment, asset spend, or store upload.

activeFounderGate.safeWorkWhileWaiting: Continue research, design, local builds, drafts, and read-only capability discovery; do not infer consent.
activeFounderGate.agentActionNext: Run the consolidated readiness preflight, record standing envelopes, and start every ready area.
activeFounderGate.successProof: The access and operations ledgers show exact capabilities, roles, envelopes, limits, blockers, and next work.

founderModel.nextFounderAction: Choose the recommended step-away setup or an assisted setup.
founderModel.nextAgentAction: Run the consolidated readiness preflight, record standing envelopes, and start every ready area.
founderModel.nextBusinessOperation: Begin research, product, design, app, landing, asset, provider, and store work as soon as each dependency is ready.

doppler.nextFounderAction: Approve Doppler setup or complete the browser login when the agent opens it; never paste a token in chat.
doppler.nextAgentAction: Refresh official docs and CLI help, verify authentication, then inventory or create the business project and configs.
